title: T2.1: Add type breakdown to SummaryView and Summary/Report handlers

text: Acceptance: (1) SummaryView in src/output.rs gains pub by_type: Vec<(String, usize)>. (2) Invocation::Summary handler counts types using "Default" for story_type == None, passes as by_type. (3) Both Report { html: false } and Report { html: true } handlers: same type counting. (4) render_summary renders "by type:" section after "by priority:". (5) New test: summary_shows_type_breakdown. (6) cargo test --test story_summary passes.
